meta.honesty: synthetic digital-twin evaluation; NOT real-hardware validation; M4.2 acceptance criterion 'Validated on IBM Quantum, IonQ, and Rigetti hardware' is NOT met. Twins ignore T1/T2, crosstalk, leakage, drift, and correlated errors. Twin-Born validation uses the true noise model (oracle calibration) — a ceiling, not a floor.

ibm-twin.note: illustrative of current IBM superconducting medians; no T1/T2, crosstalk or leakage

ionq-twin.note: illustrative of current trapped-ion medians; all-to-all ignored, no scattering

rigetti-twin.note: illustrative of current superconducting medians; no parametric-gate crosstalk
